import PL1.ExplicitMartingale
import Mathlib.Probability.Martingale.Basic

/-!
# The actual first-coordinate filtration and its Walsh conditional expectations

The filtration is the pullback of the measurable space on the first `m`
sign coordinates. Its conditional expectation is computed by invariance
under flipping any unseen coordinate.
-/

noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Filter
open scoped ENNReal NNReal Topology BigOperators ProbabilityTheory

namespace PL1.ExplicitMartingale
open Walsh WalshExpectations Noise IntrinsicGraph ScalarRealification

def prefixMap (m : ℕ) (s : Walsh.Group) : Fin m → Sign := fun j => s j

def extendPrefix (m : ℕ) (w : Fin m → Sign) : Walsh.Group :=
  fun j => if h : j < m then w ⟨j, h⟩ else 1

/-- The sigma-algebra generated by precisely the first `m` coordinates. -/
@[instance_reducible] def coordinateSpace (m : ℕ) : MeasurableSpace Walsh.Group :=
  MeasurableSpace.comap (prefixMap m) inferInstance

theorem coordinateSpace_mono : Monotone coordinateSpace := by
  intro m n hmn
  exact MeasurableSpace.comap_le_comap_of_eq_comp
    (fun w : Fin n → Sign => fun j : Fin m => w ⟨j, j.isLt.trans_le hmn⟩)
    (measurable_of_finite _) rfl

theorem coordinateSpace_le (m : ℕ) : coordinateSpace m ≤ (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace Walsh.Group) :=
  (show Measurable (prefixMap m) from
    Measurable.of_eval (fun j => measurable_pi_apply (j : ℕ))).comap_le

def coordinateFiltration : Filtration ℕ (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace Walsh.Group) where
  seq := coordinateSpace
  mono' := coordinateSpace_mono
  le' := coordinateSpace_le

theorem character_extendPrefix {F : Finset ℕ} {m : ℕ} (hF : F ⊆ Finset.range m)
    (s : Walsh.Group) : character F (extendPrefix m (prefixMap m s)) = character F s := by
  unfold character
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  simp only [extendPrefix, Finset.mem_range.mp (hF hj), dite_true, prefixMap]

theorem stronglyMeasurable_character_coordinateSpace {F : Finset ℕ} {m : ℕ}
    (hF : F ⊆ Finset.range m) : StronglyMeasurable[coordinateSpace m] (character F) := by
  have h : Measurable[coordinateSpace m]
      (fun s => character F (extendPrefix m (prefixMap m s))) :=
    (measurable_of_finite (fun w : Fin m → Sign => character F (extendPrefix m w))).comp
      (comap_measurable (prefixMap m))
  simpa only [character_extendPrefix hF] using h.stronglyMeasurable

theorem prefix_flip_mul (m j : ℕ) (hj : m ≤ j) (x : Walsh.Group) :
    prefixMap m (flip j * x) = prefixMap m x := by
  funext i
  have hij : (i : ℕ) ≠ j := by omega
  simp only [prefixMap, Pi.mul_apply, Walsh.flip, Function.update_of_ne hij, Pi.one_apply, one_mul]

/-- An unseen Walsh coordinate forces zero integral over every event in
the first-coordinate sigma-algebra. -/
theorem setIntegral_character_eq_zero_of_not_subset (m : ℕ) (F : Finset ℕ)
    (hF : ¬ F ⊆ Finset.range m) (A : Set Walsh.Group)
    (hA : MeasurableSet[coordinateSpace m] A) : ∫ x in A, character F x ∂haar = 0 := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨j, hjF, hjm⟩ := Finset.not_subset.mp hF
  have hj : m ≤ j := Nat.le_of_not_gt (by simpa only [Finset.mem_range] using hjm)
  rw [← integral_indicator (coordinateSpace_le m A hA)]
  apply integral_eq_zero_of_mul_left_eq_neg (g := flip j)
  intro x
  have hAx : flip j * x ∈ A ↔ x ∈ A := by
    obtain ⟨B, _, rfl⟩ := hA
    change prefixMap m (flip j * x) ∈ B ↔ prefixMap m x ∈ B
    rw [prefix_flip_mul m j hj]
  by_cases hx : x ∈ A
  · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem (hAx.mpr hx), Set.indicator_of_mem hx,
      character_mul, character_flip_of_mem hjF, neg_one_mul]
  · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem (fun h => hx (hAx.mp h)), Set.indicator_of_notMem hx, neg_zero]

/-- Conditional expectation in the genuine coordinate filtration acts on
Walsh characters by deleting exactly the unseen characters. -/
theorem condExp_character (m : ℕ) (F : Finset ℕ) :
    haar[character F | coordinateSpace m] =ᵐ[haar]
      fun x => if F ⊆ Finset.range m then character F x else 0 := by
  classical
  by_cases hF : F ⊆ Finset.range m
  · simp only [hF, ite_true]
    rw [condExp_of_stronglyMeasurable (coordinateSpace_le m)
      (stronglyMeasurable_character_coordinateSpace hF) (integrable_character F)]
  · simp only [hF, ite_false]
    apply Filter.EventuallyEq.symm
    apply ae_eq_condExp_of_forall_setIntegral_eq (coordinateSpace_le m) (integrable_character F)
    · intro A hA hμA
      exact (integrable_zero _ _ _).integrableOn
    · intro A hA hμA
      rw [integral_zero, setIntegral_character_eq_zero_of_not_subset m F hF A hA]
    · exact stronglyMeasurable_const.aestronglyMeasurable

section VectorWalsh

variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]

/-- Finite Walsh expansions with fixed Banach-space-valued coefficients. -/
def walshProcess (v : Finset ℕ → E) (m : ℕ) : Walsh.Group → E :=
  ∑ F ∈ (Finset.range m).powerset, fun s => character F s • v F

theorem integrable_walshProcess (v : Finset ℕ → E) (m : ℕ) :
    Integrable (walshProcess v m) haar := by
  apply integrable_finsetSum' _
  intro F hF
  exact (integrable_character F).smul_const (v F)

theorem stronglyAdapted_walshProcess (v : Finset ℕ → E) :
    StronglyAdapted coordinateFiltration (walshProcess v) := by
  intro m
  unfold walshProcess
  apply Finset.stronglyMeasurable_sum
  intro F hF
  exact (stronglyMeasurable_character_coordinateSpace (Finset.mem_powerset.mp hF)).smul
    stronglyMeasurable_const

variable [CompleteSpace E]

theorem condExp_character_smul (m : ℕ) (F : Finset ℕ) (v : E) :
    haar[(fun s => character F s • v) | coordinateSpace m] =ᵐ[haar]
      fun s => if F ⊆ Finset.range m then character F s • v else 0 := by
  classical
  have h := condExp_smul_of_aestronglyMeasurable_right (m := coordinateSpace m)
    (integrable_character F) ((integrable_character F).smul_const v)
    (stronglyMeasurable_const (b := v)).aestronglyMeasurable
  filter_upwards [h, condExp_character m F] with s hs hc
  change haar[(fun s => character F s • v) | coordinateSpace m] s =
    haar[character F | coordinateSpace m] s • v at hs
  simpa only [hc, ite_smul, zero_smul] using hs

theorem condExp_walshProcess (v : Finset ℕ → E) (k m : ℕ) :
    haar[walshProcess v m | coordinateSpace k] =ᵐ[haar]
      walshProcess v (min k m) := by
  classical
  have hfilter : ((Finset.range m).powerset.filter (fun F => F ⊆ Finset.range k)) =
      (Finset.range (min k m)).powerset := by
    ext F
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_powerset, Finset.subset_iff, Finset.mem_range]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hm, hk⟩ j hj
      exact lt_min (hk hj) (hm hj)
    · intro h
      exact ⟨fun j hj => (lt_min_iff.mp (h hj)).2, fun j hj => (lt_min_iff.mp (h hj)).1⟩
  have hsum := condExp_finsetSum (s := (Finset.range m).powerset)
    (f := fun F s => character F s • v F)
    (fun F _ => (integrable_character F).smul_const (v F)) (coordinateSpace k)
  have hall : ∀ᵐ s ∂haar, ∀ F,
      haar[(fun t => character F t • v F) | coordinateSpace k] s =
        if F ⊆ Finset.range k then character F s • v F else 0 := by
    exact ae_all_iff.mpr fun F => condExp_character_smul k F (v F)
  filter_upwards [hsum, hall] with s hs ha
  change haar[walshProcess v m | coordinateSpace k] s = _ at hs ⊢
  rw [hs]
  simp only [Finset.sum_apply]
  simp_rw [ha]
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter, hfilter]
  simp only [walshProcess, Finset.sum_apply]

theorem martingale_walshProcess (v : Finset ℕ → E) :
    Martingale (walshProcess v) coordinateFiltration haar := by
  refine ⟨stronglyAdapted_walshProcess v, ?_⟩
  intro k m hkm
  simpa only [coordinateFiltration, min_eq_left hkm] using condExp_walshProcess v k m

end VectorWalsh

variable (K : Type*) [RCLike K]

local instance betaRealNormedSpace (rates : ℕ → ℝ≥0) :
    NormedSpace ℝ (dyadicSystem K rates).IntrinsicSpace :=
  NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ K (dyadicSystem K rates).IntrinsicSpace

theorem beta_eq_walshProcess (rates : ℕ → ℝ≥0) :
    beta K rates = walshProcess (fun F =>
      ((dyadicSystem K rates).column 0 (scalarCharacterLp K 1 F) :
        (dyadicSystem K rates).IntrinsicSpace)) := by
  let := IsScalarTower.restrictScalars ℝ K (dyadicSystem K rates).IntrinsicSpace
  funext m s
  simp only [beta, kernelL1_eq_sum, map_sum, map_smul, walshProcess, Finset.sum_apply]
  rfl

/-- The manuscript's explicit process is a genuine Mathlib martingale
for the first-coordinate filtration, over both real and complex scalars. -/
theorem martingale_beta (rates : ℕ → ℝ≥0) :
    letI := NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ K (dyadicSystem K rates).IntrinsicSpace
    Martingale (beta K rates) coordinateFiltration haar := by
  let := NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ K (dyadicSystem K rates).IntrinsicSpace
  rw [beta_eq_walshProcess]
  exact martingale_walshProcess _

theorem schur_explicit_martingale :
    letI := NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ K (dyadicSystem K schurRates).IntrinsicSpace
    Martingale (beta K schurRates) coordinateFiltration haar ∧
      (∀ m s, ‖beta K schurRates m s‖ ≤ projectionBound) ∧
      (∀ s, ¬ CauchySeq (fun m => beta K schurRates m s)) :=
  ⟨martingale_beta K schurRates, norm_beta_le K schurRates, schur_beta_not_cauchy K⟩

theorem constant_explicit_martingale :
    letI := NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ K (dyadicSystem K constantRates).IntrinsicSpace
    Martingale (beta K constantRates) coordinateFiltration haar ∧
      (∀ m s, ‖beta K constantRates m s‖ ≤ projectionBound) ∧
      (∀ s, ¬ CauchySeq (fun m => beta K constantRates m s)) :=
  ⟨martingale_beta K constantRates, norm_beta_le K constantRates, constant_beta_not_cauchy K⟩

end PL1.ExplicitMartingale

declarations.label: condExp_character_smul
declarations.code:
theorem condExp_character_smul (m : ℕ) (F : Finset ℕ) (v : E) :
    haar[(fun s => character F s • v) | coordinateSpace m] =ᵐ[haar]
      fun s => if F ⊆ Finset.range m then character F s • v else 0 := by
  classical
  have h := condExp_smul_of_aestronglyMeasurable_right (m := coordinateSpace m)
    (integrable_character F) ((integrable_character F).smul_const v)
    (stronglyMeasurable_const (b := v)).aestronglyMeasurable
  filter_upwards [h, condExp_character m F] with s hs hc
  change haar[(fun s => character F s • v) | coordinateSpace m] s =
    haar[character F | coordinateSpace m] s • v at hs
  simpa only [hc, ite_smul, zero_smul] using hs

declarations.name: condExp_walshProcess
declarations.label: condExp_walshProcess
declarations.code:
theorem condExp_walshProcess (v : Finset ℕ → E) (k m : ℕ) :
    haar[walshProcess v m | coordinateSpace k] =ᵐ[haar]
      walshProcess v (min k m) := by
  classical
  have hfilter : ((Finset.range m).powerset.filter (fun F => F ⊆ Finset.range k)) =
      (Finset.range (min k m)).powerset := by
    ext F
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_powerset, Finset.subset_iff, Finset.mem_range]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hm, hk⟩ j hj
      exact lt_min (hk hj) (hm hj)
    · intro h
      exact ⟨fun j hj => (lt_min_iff.mp (h hj)).2, fun j hj => (lt_min_iff.mp (h hj)).1⟩
  have hsum := condExp_finsetSum (s := (Finset.range m).powerset)
    (f := fun F s => character F s • v F)
    (fun F _ => (integrable_character F).smul_const (v F)) (coordinateSpace k)
  have hall : ∀ᵐ s ∂haar, ∀ F,
      haar[(fun t => character F t • v F) | coordinateSpace k] s =
        if F ⊆ Finset.range k then character F s • v F else 0 := by
    exact ae_all_iff.mpr fun F => condExp_character_smul k F (v F)
  filter_upwards [hsum, hall] with s hs ha
  change haar[walshProcess v m | coordinateSpace k] s = _ at hs ⊢
  rw [hs]
  simp only [Finset.sum_apply]
  simp_rw [ha]
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter, hfilter]
  simp only [walshProcess, Finset.sum_apply]
declarations.signature:
theorem condExp_walshProcess (v : Finset ℕ → E) (k m : ℕ) :
    haar[walshProcess v m | coordinateSpace k] =ᵐ[haar]
      walshProcess v (min k m)
